name: protsenko-hub
description: Family hub: calendar, shopping, Solomiya tasks, contacts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @protsenko/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @protsenko/shared && npm exec -w api -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && npm exec -w web -- ng build --configuration=development
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm exec -w api -- prisma db seed
scripts.db:deploy: node ./scripts/with-database-env.js npm exec -w api -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test: npm run test -w api -- --runInBand && npm run test:web
